analysis: Biori ghaḍeerú and Ashret ghaḍeeró/gaḍheeró older accent the final gender vowel, unlike ordinary gáaḍu big. Liljegren2016Table7.4p153 explicitly pairs them with younger lhookeeró/ú and identifies both as older comparative formations. The independently attested gāḍhatara4119 comparison therefore supports a morphological class with ending accent, not an exceptionless rule for all short-u adjectives. Older gaḍhḗro has stem accent, so the cross-source trajectory remains unresolved.
unresolved: The inherited versus analogically assigned final accent of the comparative and the older CDIAL stem-accented form need further primary comparison. Final ú must be included in all u-ending statistical selections.
revision_reason: Primary comparative grammar checked; corrected a Unicode suffix-selection bias in the preliminary adjective statistic.
